info.title: humaniq
info.description: The humaniq API: the app-specific endpoints under `/apps/humaniq/api`. Domain objects themselves are read and written through the OpenRegister API. Errors are JSON objects with an `error` or `message` string.

servers.description: The humaniq API on a Nextcloud instance.

host.description: The host name of the Nextcloud instance.

post.summary: Activates the posted `administrationId` for the caller
post.description: Activates the posted `administrationId` for the caller. No-admin-idor guard (ADR-005 Rule 3): the id MUST resolve to one of the caller's own `AdministrationAccess` rows BEFORE it is persisted -- unknown and not-accessible both collapse to 404, so existence is never leaked to a caller without a membership row. Requires a signed-in Nextcloud user.

Requires a signed-in Nextcloud user.

post.summary: The persist-nothing "Simuleer loonstrook" pro-forma simulation (proforma-payslip design.md D4)
post.description: The persist-nothing "Simuleer loonstrook" pro-forma simulation (proforma-payslip design.md D4). The caller's access to the humaniq payroll register/schema is resolved through ObjectService under ambient RBAC BEFORE any computation (a capability probe, not a row lookup — there is no `runId`); a caller who could not see a real Payslip gets a 404, so unauthorized/unavailable collapse to the same status. Only then is the hypothetical input delegated to `ProformaPayslipService::simulate()`. No object is ever read for its data or written. Requires a signed-in Nextcloud user.

post.summary: (re)compute the WKR vrije-ruimte assessment (the `WkrAssessmentDetail` "Beoordelen" action, wkr-administration...
post.description: (re)compute the WKR vrije-ruimte assessment (the `WkrAssessmentDetail` "Beoordelen" action, wkr-administration design.md D6). Non-admin/HR callers are refused with 403 BEFORE any RBAC resolve (the `mutations()` precedent -- WKR figures are payroll-sensitive). The posted `assessmentId` must then resolve through ObjectService under the caller's ambient RBAC (unknown/ unauthorized -> 404, the `calculate()`/`adjust()` no-admin-idor pattern) before its `administrationId`/`year` are read and delegated to `WkrService::assess()`, which upserts the SAME assessment in place. Requires a signed-in Nextcloud user.
